headline: MTN Nigeria Earns 2.5 Times Airtel Data Revenue as Airtel Grows Faster
summary: MTN Nigeria generated N1.86 trillion from data between April and September, roughly 2.5 times the N739.84 billion earned by Airtel's Nigerian mobile-services business, though Airtel is growing faster.
why: Telecom revenues in key African markets reflect consumer adoption trends and competitive dynamics among major operators.

impacts.name: MTN Nigeria
impacts.why: Data revenue figures demonstrate strong commercial activity for MTN's Nigerian business.
